title: React Developer
description:
**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a Senior React Developer to strengthen our in\-house frontend engineering capability for product platform. You’ll build performant, well\-tested user interfaces and take ownership of frontend architecture decisions as we reduce our dependence on external vendors.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain features using React.js and Next.js
* Write clean, type\-safe code using TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6\+)
* Manage application state using Redux, Redux Toolkit, or Zustand
* Implement efficient data fetching and caching with React Query
* Build responsive, accessible UIs using Tailwind CSS and Material UI
* Integrate REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints
* Write unit and integration tests using Jest and React Testing Library
* Optimize application performance through code splitting and bundling (Webpack/Vite)
* Participate in code reviews and uphold frontend engineering standards
* Collaborate with design and backend teams to deliver features end\-to\-end
* Maintain CI/CD workflows for frontend deployments


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; equivalent practical experience is welcome.

title: AI CERTs Tech Lead
description:
**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a Tech Lead to own the architecture and engineering direction of the product platform while leading the team that builds and maintains it. This role combines deep technical ownership — architecture, code quality, system design — with people leadership and client\-facing technical communication, as we strengthen our in\-house engineering capability.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the technical architecture of the product LMS platform (Moodle\-based and custom)
* Design and evolve backend services using Node.js, PHP, or Python, and frontend using React.js
* Define and evolve microservices and REST API architecture
* Own Azure infrastructure design and management
* Design and maintain database architecture (MySQL/PostgreSQL)
* Implement and maintain SSO and authentication standards (OAuth 2\.0, SAML, JWT)
* Lead integrations with a wide range of third\-party and enterprise systems (LTI tools, CRM, payment gateways, analytics platforms, and other partner systems)
* Own CI/CD pipelines and containerization for the platform
* Drive system design decisions for scalability and reliability
* Lead code reviews and set engineering standards across the team
* Own technical documentation and manage vendor handover processes
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for client\-facing discussions, translating business and partner requirements into technical solutions
* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, including performance and career development
* Own cost and vendor\-spend decisions for the platform, evaluating build\-vs\-buy trade\-offs to reduce reliance on paid third\-party tools


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; equivalent practical experience is welcome.
